ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Hilo uses the microphone to listen to you when you tap the button to talk.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Hilo turns what you say into text to keep it in your book.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Hilo uses the camera to read the QR code your family gives you.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Hilo doesn't use your photos. If it ever needs them, it will ask you first.
